decisions.reason: Restricting available theme-color choices does not change any font size, weight, family, or caption typography attribute.
The palette restriction does not change style names, the PBU prefix, naming language, or covered style categories.
The source adds a Master-template palette constraint but does not change the specification or all-template coverage of the existing style system.
The restriction on selectable theme colors does not alter bullet dimensions, spacing, alignment, scaling, approved appearance, or the required green level-four bullet.
Limiting theme-color choices does not change the legacy-content migration workflow or its copy-paste stability criteria.
The theme palette decision is independent of the calendar-style date selector and its template contexts.
The palette restriction does not change word wrapping or column overflow containment behavior.
The selectable-color constraint does not alter table paste stability, column boundaries, or text-box overflow behavior.
The Master-template color palette does not affect alignment among Board Meeting fields.
The palette restriction does not affect the border behavior produced when inserting a line after a Topic.
Restricting theme-color choices does not change hard-return spacing for continuous text.
The Master-template palette decision does not change fixed-margin behavior in the Vejledning template.
